name: webai-bridge
description: Zero-Token MCP Orchestrator. Let your IDE agent delegate the hard thinking to the Web AI you already pay for (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, AI Studio) with $0 API cost, native file uploads, and zero copy-paste.
author: Eyad <Trignod.ai>

scripts.check: node --check extension/bridge.mjs && node --check extension/protocol.mjs && node --check extension/session-auth.mjs && node --check extension/response-buffer.mjs && node --check extension/content-providers.js && node --check extension/content-upload.js && node --check extension/content-core.js && node --check extension/content.js && node --check extension/popup.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8'));console.log('manifest ok')"
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/safety.test.mjs test/protocol.test.mjs test/protocol.e2e.test.mjs test/comparison.test.mjs test/milestone4.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run doctor
